title: defining max in a RangeSlider automatically filters results to that max value
body:
## 🐛 Bug description

Defining max in a RangeSlider automatically filters results to that max value

## 💭 Expected behavior

All results to come in until the user actually filters them.

## 🖥 Screenshots

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4541410/160559876-7f6185b7-f3cd-4cdf-b168-0ba7ff7ee295.png)

## Additional context

```
rangeSlider({
    container: '#price-range-slider',
    attribute: 'price',
    max:8000,
  }),

```

Adding the filter automatically is a nice future to have in some scenarios. The default should be to work with all results until the end user actually interacts with the widget.   The way instantsearch works now how do I go about removing that max filter optimaly?

comments.body: Could you clarify which behaviour you want for the max? Would it not apply the filter, but in the UI still show as 8000 as the highest value?

Exactly.  The reason to put in the max is to make the range slider usable when there is large price outliers.   But we don't want to limit the initial search results.   When the end user drags the upper bound then the upper filter should be applied.
